name: triage_software_issues
responsibility: Analyze software issues and suggest classification metadata
trigger_description: User needs to classify or triage a bug report, feature request, or software issue with labels, priority, or routing recommendations.

parts.content: Extract and analyze key signals from the issue: 1) Identify issue type (bug/feature/documentation/question). 2) Assess scope - does it affect all users, a subset, or edge cases? Note any mention of version numbers, environment specifics, or reproduction steps. 3) Gauge urgency from impact clues: crashes, data loss, workarounds available, number of affected users, business impact mentioned. 4) Identify technical domain from stack traces, error messages, or component names mentioned in title/body.

Suggest 2-4 appropriate labels following common conventions: type labels (bug, enhancement, documentation), scope labels (component or area affected), severity labels (critical for crashes/data loss, high for significant dysfunction, medium for degraded experience, low for cosmetic or nice-to-have features). Include platform/environment labels when specific (macOS, self-hosted, etc.). Avoid redundant or overlapping labels.

Determine priority tier: P0/Critical if causing crashes, data loss, or blocking many users with no workaround; P1/High if significantly degrading functionality for a meaningful user segment; P2/Medium if affecting edge cases or when workarounds exist; P3/Low for feature requests and non-urgent improvements. Explain your priority reasoning in one sentence citing the key evidence.

Recommend next step and routing: identify which team or domain expert should investigate based on technical signals (backend, frontend, infrastructure, security, etc.). Suggest immediate actions like 'needs reproduction steps', 'assign to backend team for database query review', 'requires user environment details', or 'ready for sprint planning'. If issue duplicates common patterns, note that.
